title: Innokin Endura T18E Coils
description: Maintain the performance of your Innokin Endura T18E Kit and Prism T18E tank with these premium replacement coils, crafted to deliver a perfect balance of flavour and vapour. Available in packs of five, these coils boast a 1.5ohm resistance for a classic MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping experience. They feature a 100% Japanese organic cotton wicking material to provide immaculate flavour with every draw and work best with 50/50, nic salts or high-PG e-liquids. Innokin's innovative no-spill coil swap system simplifies coil changes, allowing you to replace your coils without touching the e-liquid chamber, making maintenance clean and hassle-free. Whether you're a light, moderate, or heavy vaper, an Innokin Endura Prism coil can typically last from 1 to 3 weeks, making this 5-pack an excellent investment for 1 to 2 months of consistently rewarding vaping. You'll know it's time for a change when vapour production diminishes or your e-liquid starts to taste different. Each coil in this 5-pack is individually wrapped for quality and longevity, ensuring you always have a fresh coil to hand when you need it. Compatible with the Innokin Endura Kit, T18E , T18II , T18X, T22 Pro Kits, as well as T18E Pro & T22E tanks Please note: As these coils are shorter they are NOT Compatible with the Innokin T18 and T22 tanks. Please use the longer T18/T22 Coils for these tanks. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your pod or tank. 'Priming a coil' simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with a dab or two of e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your coil, attached it to your pod or tank, and filled up with e-liquid, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
